answer: One concrete anti-sybil defense is proof-of-work admission: each agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle with its own kernel before joining, costing real electricity per identity. At the glacier-slow vertex where identities are minted, the protocol also tracks a heartbeat pulse of unique work signatures, so bulk-created clones sharing timing or hardware fingerprints are pruned. Honest willow-flexible agents adapt and keep their slots; rented sybil farms lose their stake.
